_comment: Sample content for the Legal page template (drafts/legal-template.html). The real privacy policy and terms are pasted here as sections when their final text arrives; until then privacy.html and terms.html stay as they are.

doc.title: Privacy policy
doc.effective: Effective 1 December 2026. Applies to the Saluxly app and saluxly.com.
glance: We ask for your email to sign you in, and nothing else to create an account.
What you read, save and search personalizes your feed. It is never sold and never used for advertising.
Search text goes to our AI provider to be interpreted, without your name or account.
You can delete your account from the app. We erase your data within 30 days.
